reports.title: Venture Global Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: Our updated guidance for 2026 is as follows:
•Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA1 guidance for the full year 2026 is $10.0 billion - $10.3 billion.

◦As noted in previous quarters, changes in natural gas prices, both domestic and international, could impact Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA guidance. We assume a fixed liquefaction fee range of $21.00/MMBtu - $22.00/MMBtu for our remaining unsold cargos in 2026 in support of our guidance, reflecting market forward prices and recently executed cargo sales.
◦+/- $1.00/MMBtu change in fixed liquefaction fees will impact our full year 2026 Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA by $20 million - $30 million.
•We expect to export 152 - 154 cargos from the Calcasieu Project and 357 - 364 cargos from the Plaquemines Project in 2026.

desk.headline: Revenue up 43% to $4.8bn, beat; full-year EBITDA outlook raised to $10.0–10.3bn
results: Revenue rose 43% to $4.8bn on record sales, mainly from more LNG out of the Plaquemines plant and better selling prices after gas costs.
Adjusted EBITDA rose 69% to $2.6bn; diluted EPS of $0.96 was lifted by a $1.37bn non-cash gain on interest rate swaps.
The company exported 124 cargos, up from 100, and Plaquemines Phase 1 started commercial operations on 31 Oct 2026.
It signed 2.0 mtpa of new or larger 20-year supply deals, including ConocoPhillips (1.0 mtpa) and China Gas (0.5 mtpa).
Long-term debt rose to $42.9bn from $33.4bn at the end of 2025 as building continues; a $0.04 dividend was declared.

guidance.summary: Venture Global raised its 2026 adjusted EBITDA outlook to $10.0–10.3bn from $8.7–9.1bn and narrowed its cargo range upward. The outlook assumes $21–22/MMBtu for the few cargos not yet sold.

points: Management expects volatile and possibly higher LNG prices this winter, citing low European gas storage and limited Middle East supply.
About 99% of 2026 cargos are now sold, and the CEO said long-term contract demand is strong, especially from Asian buyers.
The 2027 view of 575–625 cargos was kept, with full 2027 guidance due on the next call; market prices will be the main driver of 2027 earnings.
The planned off-grid power business for data centres targets about 5 GW by end-2031; no customer deals have been signed yet.
The finance chief flagged pressure on margins as Plaquemines moves to long-term contract prices, plus start-up costs for CP2 and the power business.
call.source: Call transcript — The Motley Fool, 10 Nov 2026

watch: The first full 2027 outlook, and how much lower contract prices at Plaquemines weigh on margins.
Progress at CP2 towards first LNG in mid-2027 and expansion investment decisions in 2027.
Whether the data-centre power plan wins its first customers, and what it costs.
